## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A truncated series over Legendre polynomials on [-1, 1]
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legendre_polynomials): Coefficients[k]
// weights P_k.
type LegendreSeries
    implements IValue
{
    Coefficients: Array<Number>;
}

// A truncated series over physicists' Hermite polynomials
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hermite_polynomials): Coefficients[k]
// weights H_k.
type HermiteSeries
    implements IValue
{
    Coefficients: Array<Number>;
}

// A polynomial over the Bernstein basis of degree count - 1 on [0, 1]
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bernstein_polynomial): Coefficients[k]
// weights the k-th Bernstein basis polynomial. The coefficients act as control
// values, as in a Bezier curve.
type BernsteinPolynomial
    implements IValue
{
    Coefficients: Array<Number>;
}

// A dense polynomial in two variables. The column index of Coefficients is
// the power of x and the row index is the power of y, so the entry at
// (i, j) multiplies x^i * y^j.
type BivariatePolynomial
    implements IValue
{
    Coefficients: Array2D<Number>;
}

// A truncated real Fourier series
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fourier_series). Term k oscillates at k times
// the Fundamental frequency; CosineCoefficients[0] is the constant (DC) term and
// SineCoefficients[0] is ignored. The two arrays have equal length.
type FourierSeries
    implements IValue
{
    Fundamental: Frequency;
    CosineCoefficients: Array<Number>;
    SineCoefficients: Array<Number>;
}
```
